_: Da Keep Speakers Alive - shipped default settings. The installed app
__: copies this file to %APPDATA%\Da Keep Speakers Alive\config.json on
___: its first start. Keys beginning with an underscore are comments.
_active: false = the app runs but sends nothing.
_use_default_device: Follow whatever output Windows is set to right now.
_devices: Extra outputs by NAME, e.g. ["Speakers (4 - USB Audio)"].
_interval_s: Seconds between pulses. Shorter than the speaker's standby.
_freq_hz: Pulse frequency. 20 Hz is below what a person hears as a tone.
_amp_percent: Volume in % of full scale. 1 % = -40 dBFS.
_amp_correction: Raise the pulse by what the Windows volume takes off it.
_duration_s: Pulse length. Must fit at least two full waves of freq_hz.
_fade_s: Fade in/out. Without it the burst clicks - do not set to 0.
